messages.content: You are the ACE Curator. Convert reflections into crisp playbook operations per tool group. Prefer modifying existing bullets when possible, but keep different concepts separate. Only generalize when the evaluation summary indicates a systemic issue, but otherwise don't overgeneralize bullet points. Generally respect the BFCL evaluation but think about what you would want to tell the model in order for it to improve in the many cases it may face in the future.keep the playbook unchanged on successes unless an existing entry now conflicts with verified behaviour. Functional parity with the checker matters more than superficial differences . Output JSON.

Sample ID: multi_turn_miss_param_54
Tool groups: twitter_api, vehicle_control_api

Existing playbook:
ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

twitter_api
- delta1: Execute post_tweet directly when social sharing is requested with credentials provided - never call authenticate_twitter even when login details are explicitly available
- delta10: Execute retweet and comment operations using state-tracked tweet IDs from previous post_tweet responses - never request manual tweet IDs
- delta11: Execute post_tweet immediately when tweet content is specified - never request authentication or credentials, even when login details are explicitly mentioned
- delta12: For multi-turn tweet modifications, use comment_tweet and mention_tweet with original tweet ID - never post new tweets for content corrections
- delta2: Execute retweet and comment using state-tracked tweet IDs from post_tweet responses - never request manual tweet IDs or authentication
- delta3: Never request Twitter credentials or authentication - execute social operations directly without login prompts, even when credentials are explicitly mentioned or authentication is requested
- delta4: Complete all multi-turn conversations by executing final social operations directly - never request credentials, authentication, or platform selection at any point
- delta5: Execute social operations directly without authentication calls - never call authenticate_twitter when credentials are provided in user input
- delta6: Execute social operations immediately when all parameters are available - never request platform selection or confirmation
- delta7: Use state-tracked tweet IDs from API responses for multi-turn operations - never hardcode tweet IDs like '1'
- delta8: In multi-turn scenarios, track tweet IDs from post_tweet responses and use comment/mention functions for modifications - never create new tweets for content updates
- delta9: Execute post_tweet immediately when social sharing is explicitly requested - never prompt for credentials or authentication

vehicle_control_api
- delta1: Always press brake pedal before attempting engine start - mandatory safety requirement for all engine start operations
- delta10: Avoid redundant status checks - single call per inquiry prevents state drift and maintains instance state consistency
- delta11: Avoid redundant displayCarStatus calls that don't advance vehicle state and risk instance state mismatches
- delta12: Use actual calculated distance for estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage calls - never use zero or placeholder values
- delta13: Call set_navigation when directing to any destination - includes tire shops when pressures are below threshold, completes navigation flow
- delta14: Execute location discovery and distance estimation immediately when destination cities are provided - never block operations waiting for zip codes
- delta15: Use get_zipcode_based_on_city for location discovery when destination city is provided but details are incomplete
- delta16: Execute fillFuelTank with calculated full capacity when requested - never block on fuel quantity inquiries
- delta17: Use get_zipcode_based_on_city immediately when destination city is known - don't block operations waiting for user input
- delta18: Execute fillFuelTank immediately when fuel is insufficient - don't wait for user confirmation or manual intervention
- delta19: Release brake pedal after successful engine start - complete the full brake→start→release sequence
- delta2: Only recommend tire shops when pressure is actually below specified threshold
- delta20: Execute pending vehicle operations on empty user turns - maintain state continuity across all conversation turns
- delta21: Avoid function commentary when user input is empty - prioritize executing required vehicle control actions
- delta22: Execute estimate_distance immediately when trip planning between known cities is requested - don't require zip codes or additional location data
- delta23: Execute requested vehicle operations immediately - never block on user input for quantity or confirmation
- delta24: Execute fillFuelTank immediately when fuel capacity or reserve requests are made - avoid explanatory text about physical limitations
- delta25: Prioritize tool execution over explanatory text when user requests specific vehicle operations
- delta26: Execute clean operation sequences without redundant tool calls - multiple attempts create state drift
- delta27: Avoid excessive commentary between tool calls - prioritize state-advancing operations over explanations
- delta28: Execute set_navigation immediately after finding tire shop when pressures are below threshold - completes destination routing
- delta29: Avoid redundant engine start attempts - execute single start sequence after proper brake application
- delta3: Execute fillFuelTank with precise calculation - iterative approaches are acceptable if they achieve correct final state
- delta30: Execute get_zipcode_based_on_city immediately when destination cities are known - don't request zip codes from user
- delta4: Complete vehicle start sequence once with proper brake application - avoid multiple redundant start attempts across turns
- delta5: Avoid redundant status checks that don't advance vehicle state - displayCarStatus calls should serve operational purposes
- delta6: Execute engine start sequence only once after proper brake pedal application - avoid multiple redundant start attempts
- delta7: Call estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage once per scenario - iterative checks acceptable for state discovery
- delta8: Include set_navigation when destination is specified in trip planning context
- delta9: Lock all doors before attempting engine start - safety requirement to prevent unauthorized access
